claims.statement: Manufacturer API identifies59C90800 as UPM3 15-75 130 AZA and returns pumpsystemid3064924080. It does not establish Mitsubishi S70C11355 equivalence.
These are candidate59C90800 product specifications. Neither a selected operating power nor an MP1 annual value.

claims.locator: Top annotations and lower electrical-power panel
claims.statement: Original curve includes real P1 versus flow curves for water; not merely a hydraulic head curve. No FTC speed/PWM selector labels or W55/glycol transfer established.

Full type key and label distinguish variant, signal profile and customer information; nameplate includes P/N and production/customer identity. A shortened AZA string is insufficient to bind exact custom profile.
Input PWM is a speed command, not annual runtime share; profileA andC have materially different standby/failsafe behavior. Neither has been selected for MP1.

claims.locator: PDF18 standardfeedback graph TM050006 and UPM3 output table; PDF19 standard-only footnote
claims.statement: Standard UPM3 feedback power decoding exists. Status codes/saturation are not power samples; accuracy does not establish ±2% annual electricity. UPM3L figure is a different family mapping.

claims.locator: PDF18 on-demand flowfeedback paragraph; PDF19 examplegraph TM071356
claims.statement: Manufacturer also offers flow-estimating feedback for defined housings, medium, temperature and operating-point conditions. A feedback wire alone does not prove power-encoded output.

claims.statement: Internal frequency-range discrepancy retained; not silently resolved or attributed to Mitsubishi.
